This product comes in a flat pack and you need to read the instructions carefully in order to assemble it. My husband thought he could put it together without reading the instructions and he failed. Then I had to get two strong guys to put it together. Just stretching the bungie cords that attach the mat to the frame of the trampoline takes a great amount of strength. On first appearances the trampoline mat looks too small for the frame but it does fit as it has to stretched very tightly.The trampoline works great now it's assembled. You need to hold on to the handle as you jump but the height of the handle is adjustable. I did nearly return this product because of the difficulty of assembly.

I have a Vevor portable 10' basketball goal with a 52" backboard. I didn't have the bottom fully weighted yet, and it fell over in a storm. It is such great quality, the only damage was the hoop was bent a little. I ordered this as a replacement, and it's a perfect fit. The black matches better, and I am super grateful to Vevor for making quality products. Honestly, I probably could have fixed the hoop, but I'm a female and just ordered this replacement for convenience. It should fit standard Vevor basketball goals. Any other brand of goal and hoop would have been shattered and completely destroyed. Not only did my heavy goal withstand the fall, it was my fault for not having the proper weight on it. If you have any doubts about ordering a Vevor basketball goal or hoop- don't hesitate. I would give everything 10 stars if possible!
Great basketball hoop for the price! Very sturdy, easy to assemble, and perfect for daily use. The quality exceeded my expectations and my family loves it. Highly recommend!
This hooked right into our Vevor basketball hoop! Great quality!
